fixtures.preview: Mauricio Pochettino takes his first training session today and is due to take charge at Anfield (3:30am Mon 23 Nov Sydney) after only three training days.
talking_points: Pochettino replaced the sacked Michael Carrick on 13 Nov on a deal to summer 2029, with United paying about £7.4m to free him from the USA job, per Sky Sports.
United are 18th on 8 points from 10, their worst-ever Premier League start, and drew 4-4 with Aston Villa on 8 Nov.
Liverpool were 4th on 18 points in the 8 Nov table (not updated since) and sit 8th in the Champions League table on 9 points.
Line-ups and injuries aren't confirmed, so who Pochettino can pick is unclear until his first press conference.

fixtures.preview: Matchday 5 in Lisbon (8pm local, 7am Thu 26 Nov Sydney), with United 17th on 6 points and Sporting 10th on 9 after four games.
Brentford (8th, 14 points in the 8 Nov table) visit Old Trafford at 3pm UK time (2am Sun 29 Nov Sydney), likely Pochettino's home debut.
A Wednesday-night trip to Tyneside at about 8pm UK time (7am Thu 3 Dec Sydney) against a 12th-placed side on 12 points in the 8 Nov table; one outlet lists 8:15pm.
Coventry, one place above United in 17th on 9 points in the 8 Nov table, visit at 3pm UK time (2am Sun 6 Dec Sydney) in a relegation-zone six-pointer.
Sydney go to Brisbane (6:40pm Brisbane time, 7:40pm Sydney) in Matchweek 5, off a 4-1 win over Central Coast on 6 Nov.
talking_points: Al Hassan Toure scored his second hat-trick for the club in the 4-1 win over the Mariners, and Gabriel Popovic scored his first Sydney goal.
Head coach Patrick Kisnorbo said after that win that 'the best is yet to come'.
No squad or injury list has been published for Brisbane, and the ladder wasn't re-checked.

fixtures.preview: The Big Blue at Allianz Stadium on Sunday 6 December at 5pm.
A Grand Final rematch in Auckland at 5pm New Zealand time (3pm Sydney).
A Friday-night home game against Perth Glory at 7:40pm.
A Monday-night home game against Macarthur FC at 7pm.

notes: Many sources blocked automated access or returned thin results this run (Rebel, Stan, UEFA, A-Leagues match lists, Coles, Woolworths, Aldi), so some details are carried from earlier runs and flagged on the item.

Man Utd: Liverpool line-ups and injuries aren't confirmed. Table positions are from Sky's 8 Nov table and may have moved. The Newcastle kick-off is listed as 8pm by Sky and 8:15pm by one other outlet.

Broadcasters: Nations Championship on Stan Sport is confirmed by rugby.com.au. Premier League on Stan Sport and A-League on Paramount+ were not re-confirmed this run, and I couldn't confirm the Champions League broadcaster, so it is blank. No Champions League games are in Big Matches for that reason.

Sydney FC: Perth and Macarthur dates come from the earlier check. The club's page lists home games only, so a game between 21 Nov and 6 Dec may be missing. Sydney Kings v Perth Wildcats (Sun 6 Dec, Olympic Park) turned up in search only and wasn't confirmed.

Local: the earlier 'high school tour on 19 Nov' was dropped because the Term 4 calendar shows tours on 9 and 17 Nov. School dates come from the Term 4 calendars and the Week 6 Principal Updates and may change. Nothing was found for the second school.
Groceries: only items confirmed in OzBargain's 18–24 Nov catalogue roundup are listed. No fresh fruit, veg, meat or egg specials, and no matcha, were found, and Aldi prices weren't available.
Deals: nothing new was found for football boots, running shoes or matcha pop-ups. Rebel's Black Friday sale is reported to start around 23 Nov but couldn't be opened.
Son and daughter sections are thin: no junior parkrun, Pokémon, Roblox or Minecraft event (other than the Luna Park show opening 18 Dec) and no kids' author talk in Sydney was confirmed.
